mapper.select: SELECT record.product_code, MAX(record.product_name) as product_name, SUM(record.delivered_num) as delivered_num FROM wms_deliver_goods_record as record WHERE record.deliver_time >= #{startTime} AND record.deliver_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY record.product_code ORDER BY SUM(record.delivered_num) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT record.product_code, MAX(record.product_name) as product_name, record.warehouse_code, MAX(record.warehouse_name) as warehouse_name, SUM(record.delivered_num) as delivered_num FROM wms_deliver_goods_record as record WHERE record.deliver_time >= #{query.startTime} AND record.deliver_time <= #{query.endTime}
AND record.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.productCode},'%')
AND record.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.productName},'%')
AND record.warehouse_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.warehouseCode},'%')
AND record.warehouse_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.warehouseName},'%')
GROUP BY record.product_code,record.warehouse_code
